source_text: Similarly, the British Medical Association (BMA) classifies non-therapeutic male circumcision as ethically contentious, noting in 2019 guidance that the body of evidence for prophylactic health benefits remains insufficient to support its routine performance on minors and advising deferral until the child attains capacity for informed consent. [81]
